steps.title: Step 1 — Repeat After Your Tutor
steps.content:
Introducing Yourself → Introducing Your Coworker

My name is Chen. → This is Robert.
My name is Ronald. → This is Janette.
My name is Esther. → This is Tony.
My name is Rachelle. → This is Carol.
My name is Arthur. → This is Jisoo.

We are coworkers. • We are teammates.

tutorNotes.text: "Let's practice today's patterns."
Read the instruction
Read each sentence. Ask the student to repeat.
Adjust speed according to the student's level.
Correct mispronounced words after reading.
Nice! Let's go to the next part.

steps.title: Step 2 — Fill in the Blanks
steps.instructionEn: Fill in with "My name is," "This is," or "We are."
steps.instructionKr: "My name is", "This is", "We are" 중 하나를 넣으세요.
steps.content:
Introducing Yourself → Introducing Your Coworker

_______ Chen. → _______ Robert.

tutorNotes.text: Read the instruction to the student.
"is it clear?"
For lower-level students, explain that column 1 uses "My name is," column 2 uses "This is," and the bottom uses "We are."
Nice! Let's go to the next part.

steps.title: Step 3 — Read the Dialogue
steps.instructionEn: Read the dialogue with your tutor.

dialogue.en: Good morning. My name is Evan. It's my first day today.
dialogue.kr: 안녕하세요. 제 이름은 에반입니다. 오늘은 제 첫 출근 날입니다.

dialogue.en: Pleased to meet you, Evan. My name is Minho. This is Sandra. We are coworkers.
dialogue.kr: 만나서 반갑습니다, 에반 씨. 제 이름은 민호입니다. 이쪽은 산드라 씨입니다. 우리는 동료입니다.

dialogue.en: Pleased to meet you, too, Minho and Sandra.
dialogue.kr: 민호 씨, 산드라 씨, 저도 만나서 반갑습니다.

I will read the tutor parts, you will read the student parts.

challenge.scenarioEn: A new coworker joins your team. Edison is beside you. Using today's key expressions and the table below, introduce yourself and your coworkers.  Then, say that you are coworkers.
challenge.scenarioKr: 새 동료가 팀에 합류했습니다. 오늘의 핵심 표현과 아래 표를 사용하여 자기소개를 하고 동료들을 소개해 보세요. 그런 다음 여러분이 동료라는 것도 말해 보세요.

discussion.instructionEn: Choose one category, then answer the questions.

categories.title: YOUR JOB
questions: What do you do at work?
What is one thing you often do in your job?
What part of your job do you like?

categories.title: YOUR TEAM
questions: Do you work alone or with a team?
What do you usually do with your team?
Do you like working with your team? Why?

categories.title: A NEW COWORKER
questions: What would you say when you meet a new coworker?
What would you ask a new coworker first?
How can you help a new coworker on the first day?

tutorNotes.text: "Now, let's have a discussion."
Read the instruction.
Ask the student to choose a category.
You can ask follow-up questions and have a natural conversation with the student until the time for feedback.
